_comment: Org-wide protection for every repo's default branch. Applied to the
shamwari-ai org; kept here so the configuration is reviewable and
reproducible rather than existing only in the GitHub dashboard.
Two deliberate choices, both driven by the org's actual shape:
1. required_approving_review_count is 0. The org has one member. A
count of 1 would make every PR unmergeable by its own author, which
is a lockout, not a safeguard. The pull_request rule still forces
changes through a PR with resolved review threads; raise this to 1
the day a second maintainer joins.
2. bypass_actors grants OrganizationAdmin an always-bypass. The repo
split imports history with `git subtree split` pushed straight to
main; that is a direct push and the pull_request rule would reject
it. Narrow or remove this once the extractions are done.
required_status_checks is deliberately absent. Naming a check that has
never run makes every PR unmergeable — add contexts here only after CI
has reported them at least once on that repo.
name: org-wide-main-protection
